column1: # Complete native UI messages: English<TAB>简体中文. Compiled as hP.
# Sources reviewed against the installed game's native string data. Join fixed
# native continuation lines into messages; never add resolution-sized fragments.
# P owns whole visible sentences before word/name matching and uses the shared
# paragraph layout. Terms follow data/runtime/translations.tsv and data/runtime/help-translations.tsv.

# Fortress revisit introduction: complete heading and semantic paragraphs.
A Dwarven Outpost Revisited: You have returned.

How have your sturdy charges fared in your absence? Have they gone on adventures or moved on to richer delving at new frontier settlements? Perhaps they are all still here, unwilling to leave the magnificent fortress you prepared for them.

column1: Leave it to the besotted dullard to miss the finer points of discourse.  I'm leaving.  Do reflect.
column2: “也只有你这醉醺醺的蠢货，才会听不懂话里的意思。我走了。好好反省吧。”

column1: You'll need more goods to make this arrangement.  All I see here is not enough.
column2: “想达成这笔交易，你还得拿出更多货物。这里的所有东西加起来也不够。”

column1: Even with your combined trade goods, such as they are, I can't fathom you ending up with the items you desire.
column2: “就算把你这些货物全加在一起，我也看不出你怎么换得到想要的东西。”

column1: Ah, wonderful.  Thank you for your business.
I will see that our leader gets this offering.
column2: “我会把这份赠礼交到我们的领袖手中。”

column1: Take what you wish.  I can't stop you.
column2: “想拿什么就拿吧。我阻止不了你。”

column1: You wish to make an offering to our leader?  This would please us greatly.  What do you offer?
column2: “你想向我们的领袖献礼？我们会非常高兴。你要献上什么？”

column1: You wish to make an offering?  We love gifts.
[Laughs uproariously]  You had me going there.  Obviously, your copious wit is matched only by your industry!
column2: “[放声大笑] 我差点当真了。显然，只有你的勤劳才配得上你这么出众的机智！”

column1: I am a merchant, yes.  You see, I wish to trade.  Which of my goods do you desire?
column2: “是的，我是个商人。你看，我想做笔交易。你想要我的哪些货物？”

column1: Yes, and trade we will!  Simply tell me what interests you and what you're prepared to offer in exchange.
column2: “没错，我们就来交易吧！告诉我你看中了什么，以及准备拿什么来交换。”

column1: Ah, but my goods are not free!  What do you offer in trade?
column2: “啊，可我的货物不是白送的！你拿什么来换？”

column1: These _are_ fine items, aren't they?  Now, what do offer for them?
column2: “这些可都是好东西，对吧？那么，你拿什么来换？”

column1: For me?  At no price?  I can accept your offer, or perhaps you wish to trade.
column2: “给我的？不用付钱？我可以收下你的礼物，或者你其实想做笔交易？”

column1: Are these gifts?  Do you wish to trade?
column2: “这些是礼物吗？你想做笔交易？”

column1: My stones, are you giving me those?  Do you wish to trade or to make an offering to our leader?
column2: “我的石头啊，你要把那些送给我？你是想交易，还是想向我们的领袖献礼？”

column1: You truly despise life, don't you?  I am beside myself with grief.  Perhaps we will show you how they suffered.
column2: “你真是蔑视生命，不是吗？我悲痛得难以自持。也许我们该让你体会它们遭受的痛苦。”

column1: Once a beautiful tree, and now?  It is a rude bauble, fit only for your kind.
column2: “它曾是一棵美丽的树，现在呢？却成了粗俗的小玩意，只配给你们这种族用。”

column1: I see your low race still revels in death.  That poor, gentle creature...
column2: “看来你们这低劣的种族仍以杀戮为乐。那可怜而温顺的生灵……”

column1: # Diplomatic meeting: complete titled participants and the dwarf liaison's
# opening/farewell scripts. Names are typed fields, never per-save literals.
# Keep each speech's sentences together, including its native speaker color.
{p}: I am your liaison from the Mountainhomes. Let's discuss your situation.
column2: {p}：我是来自山国都城的联络员。让我们谈谈你们的近况。

column1: {p}: Farewell, {p}. I look forward to our meeting next year. Our fortunes rise and fall together.
column2: {p1}：再见，{p2}。期待明年与你再次会面。我们的命运休戚与共。

column1: # Complete native diplomatic meeting topics, scripts, replies and dynamic clauses.
{p}: You have disrespected the trees in this area, but this is what we have come to expect from your stunted kind. Further abuse cannot be tolerated. Let this be a warning to you.
column2: {p}：你们不敬这里的树木，不过我们早料到你们这些矮个子会这样。我们绝不会容忍进一步的摧残。好自为之。

column1: {p}: What a pleasant surprise! Not a single tree here weeps from the abuses meted out with such ease by your people. Joy! The dwarves have turned a page, not that we would make paper. A travesty! Perhaps it is better said that the dwarves have turned over a new leaf, and the springtime for our two races has only just begun.
column2: {p}：真是令人惊喜！这里竟没有一棵树因你们族人随手施加的暴行而哭泣。太好了！矮人翻开了新的一页——当然，我们可不造纸，那简直是暴行！或许该说，矮人如新叶般焕然一新，我们两族的春天才刚刚开始。

column1: {p}: Although we do not always see eye to eye (ha!), I bid you farewell. May you someday embrace nature as you embrace the rocks and mud.
column2: {p}：虽然我们不总能平视彼此（哈！），还是就此告别吧。愿你们有一天能像拥抱岩石和泥土那样拥抱自然。

column1: {p}: Greetings from the woodlands. We have much to discuss.
column2: {p}：向你们致以林地的问候。我们有许多事要谈。

column1: {p}: It has been an honor, noble {p}. I bid you farewell.
{p}: Greetings, noble dwarf. There is much to discuss.
column2: {p}：你好，尊贵的矮人。我们有许多事要谈。

column1: {p}: Again on behalf of the Merchants' Guild, let me bid farewell to you and your stout dwarves.
column2: {p}：请允许我再次代表商人行会，向你和你健壮的矮人族人道别。

column1: {p}: On behalf of the Merchants' Guild, let me extend greetings to your people. There is much to discuss.
column2: {p}：请允许我代表商人行会，向你们的族人致以问候。我们有许多事要谈。

column1: {p}: I don't know very much about the outside world. I wish I had more to tell you.
column2: {p}：我对外面的世界所知不多。真希望能告诉你更多消息。

column1: {p}: There is much to share... (Information added to Civilizations/World Info)
column2: {p}：有许多消息要分享……（信息已添加至政权／世界信息）

column1: {p}: The world is the same as ever.
{p}: Peace is calling out to us. How do you respond?
column2: {p}：和平正在呼唤我们。你们如何回应？

column1: {p}: It's such a pleasant place you've carved out for yourselves...
column2: {p}：你们开辟的这片家园真是宜人……

column1: {p}: Let's discuss the state of our current agreements...
column2: {p}：让我们谈谈现有协议的履行情况……

column1: {p}: The Mountainhomes have some need of the same goods you have requested, sadly, so there is no export agreement to be had. We will still try to fill your needs as best we can.
column2: {p}：遗憾的是，山国都城也需要你们所求的那些货物，因此无法达成出口协议。不过，我们仍会尽力满足你们的需求。

column1: {p}: Remember, trade agreements strengthen bonds. Please consider an import agreement next year.
column2: {p}：请记住，贸易协议能增进双方的情谊。请考虑在明年达成进口协议。

column1: {p}: You continue to impress! I have come empowered to elevate this land in the eyes of our realm.
column2: {p}：你们的表现依然出色！我此次受命前来，提升这片领地在我国的地位。

column1: {p}: Well then, we have finalized the import agreement. Feel free to go over the documents.
column2: {p}：那么，我们已经敲定进口协议了。请随意查阅相关文件。

column1: {p}: Merit deserves a reward, and I come empowered to establish this colony as an official land of our realm.
column2: {p}：功绩理应得到嘉奖，我此次受命前来，将这处殖民地正式纳入我国领土。

column1: Can you imagine the trade wagons? Of course, there are responsibilities, and the nobility must live well.
column2: 你能想象那些贸易货车吗？当然，也有相应的责任，而且贵族必须享有优渥的生活。

column1: Do you have anyone suitable to recommend for elevation?
column2: 你有合适的人选推荐晋封吗？

column1: We will gladly do as you ask and strengthen our bonds of friendship.
column2: 我们很乐意照你们的请求去做，增进双方的友谊。

column1: Sadly, we do not possess this object. Best of luck in your search.
column2: 遗憾的是，我们并没有这件物品。祝你寻找顺利。

column1: Give up this childish errand. We do not part with our treasures lightly.
column2: 放弃这幼稚的差事吧。我们不会轻易交出自己的珍宝。

column1: Your claim is worthless here. Trade your lives if you must.
column2: 你们的要求在这里毫无分量。有本事就拿命来换。

column1: I hear the call. Let us stop this war.
column2: 我听到了呼唤。让我们结束这场战争。

column1: We will drown out the call with the screams of your dying. Begone.
column2: 我们会用你们临死的惨叫淹没那呼唤。滚吧。

column1: I can scarcely believe this good news! I have some recommendations.
column2: 简直不敢相信有这样的好消息！我有一些人选可以推荐。

column1: Flattering, but we'd rather maintain our distance from the homeland.
column2: 承蒙厚爱，但我们更愿意与故土保持距离。

column1: We can abide by this. Let us work toward mutual co-existence.
column2: 我们可以遵守。让我们为和平共处而努力。

column1: Our needs exceed your allowances. Relax. They're only trees.
column2: 我们的需求超出了你们的限额。放轻松，不过是些树罢了。

column1: We can grant this request. Let's discuss the specifics, though...
column2: 我们可以答应。不过，让我们先谈谈具体细节……

column1: We cannot stop production just because of your quaint sensibilities.
column2: 我们不会仅仅因为你们古怪的顾忌就停止生产。

column1: {p}: We elves are partial in particular to the trees in the forests surrounding your lands. Although we are loath to spare a single branch to your senseless slaughter, we are willing to ask that you cap your tree-fells at {u} until we next meet. I will try to return next year as I am able.
column2: {p}：我们精灵尤其珍爱你们领地周围森林中的树木。虽然我们连一根树枝都不愿让你们肆意摧残，还是愿意请你们在下次会面前，将砍伐量限制在{u}棵以内。我会尽可能在明年回来。

column1: {p}: Whatever possessed you to brave these wilds, where our animal friends are even larger than your kind than usual, we do not know. But know that this land is sacred to us, these trees more than any others. Although we are loath to spare a single branch to your senseless slaughter, we are willing to ask that you cap your tree-fells at {u} until we next meet. I will try to return next year as I am able. And beware.
column2: {p}：我们不明白是什么驱使你们勇闯这片荒野，这里的动物朋友比平常更加高大，远超你们这些小个子。但你们要知道，这片土地对我们而言是神圣的，这里的树木更胜其他。虽然我们连一根树枝都不愿让你们肆意摧残，还是愿意请你们在下次会面前，将砍伐量限制在{u}棵以内。我会尽可能在明年回来。还有，当心点。

column1: {p}: We can part with at most {d} trees, butcher.
column2: {p}：最多只能让你们砍{d}棵树，刽子手。

column1: The world generator is having trouble placing enough civilizations.  Make sure your parameters and presets offer enough low-to-mid savagery, evil/good appropriate, biome appropriate squares to establish sites.  High savagery (66+) blocks civilization placement -- make sure your parameters and presets offer at least small pockets of low-to-mid savagery areas.  If you have very few biome types and are placing good or evil regions, they'll often crowd out the civilizations as well.  Alternatively, you can reduce the number of civilizations required by the parameters.
column2: 世界生成器无法放置足够的政权。请确保参数和预设提供足够的中低野性、善恶属性与生物群系均合适的方格来建立地点。高野性（66 以上）会阻止政权落位；请确保至少存在少量中低野性区域。若生物群系种类过少，善良或邪恶区域也常会挤占政权的空间。也可以减少参数要求的政权数量。

column2: 世界生成器无法放置可操控政权。例如，矮人需要既非善良也非邪恶、非野蛮且不被海洋包围的山地方格。请确保参数和预设提供足够的此类方格。也可以取消参数中的可操控政权要求；这样将只能使用冒险者，前提是存在合适的政权。
